core.label: Core Orchestrators
core.description: Central control plane — intent routing, TDD enforcement, governance, master orchestration, audit, security, conversation

orchestrators.name: MasterOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Top-level orchestration — routes intents, manages 9-stage audit pipeline, coordinates all other orchestrators

orchestrators.name: IntentRouter
orchestrators.description: Classifies user intent and routes to the appropriate orchestrator using LENS-aware semantic ranking

orchestrators.name: TDDOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Enforces RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle — CORE-008 compliance, test-first mandate, golden test validation

orchestrators.name: EnforcementOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Pre-commit governance — validates all 35 CORE rules, blocks violations, writes audit trail to SQLite

orchestrators.name: WorkflowOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: YAML workflow template execution engine — runs detect-fix-rescan-loop and other workflow primitives

orchestrators.name: ConversationOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Multi-turn conversation management — state persistence, context aggregation, response streaming

orchestrators.name: AuditOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: 19-point production readiness audit — P0/P1/P2 scanning, convergence loop, SQLite activity logging

domain.label: Domain Orchestrators
domain.description: Specialized capabilities — planning, refactoring, SDLC workflow, domain intelligence, dashboard generation

orchestrators.name: PlanningOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Structured planning — phase decomposition, gap catalogue, TDD sequence generation

orchestrators.name: DomainOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Domain-specific intelligence — coordinates LENS analysis with domain knowledge synthesis

orchestrators.name: RefactoringOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Intelligent refactoring — duplication detection, code smell remediation, CORE-035 compliance

orchestrators.name: SDLCWorkflowOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Full SDLC workflow — from requirement to deployment with governance checkpoints

orchestrators.name: DashboardOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Static dashboard generation — landing pages, per-repo dashboards, SQLite-backed metrics views

orchestrators.name: EnhancedPlanningOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Advanced planning with ROI scoring, wave decomposition, and audit-driven auto-planning (ENH-059)

support.label: Support Orchestrators
support.description: Infrastructure — health checks, vacuum cleanup, upgrades, onboarding, digest, sweep, quality, debugging

orchestrators.name: HealthOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: All 22 orchestrator health endpoints — production readiness validation and H-series checks

orchestrators.name: VacuumOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Markdown sprawl + root clutter cleanup — dry-run gate, 30-day retention, CORE-002 enforcement

orchestrators.name: UpgradeOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Inflight upgrade — validate requirements, fetch origin/main, merge if ahead, run audit fix

orchestrators.name: BulkDigestOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Batch content ingestion — 3-pipeline processing (extract, transform, load) for large repositories

orchestrators.name: DigestSessionOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Single-session content digestion with LENS analysis and knowledge persistence

orchestrators.name: SweepCatalogueOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: CORE-064 sweep completeness — exhaustive issue cataloguing, no partial sweeps

orchestrators.name: SetupOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Environment setup — MCP configuration, VS Code settings, dependency validation

orchestrators.name: OnboardingOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Repository onboarding — LENS analysis, security assessment (P0/P1/P2), SQLite dashboard generation

orchestrators.name: RepositoryOnboardingOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Full repository onboarding with LENS V3 — LLM business language + phase 21 SQLite integration

orchestrators.name: DebuggerOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Debug session management — log capture, governance violation detection, automated fix plans

orchestrators.name: CortexDocsOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Documentation site orchestration — DOC-REFRESH-001 pipeline, JSON catalog generation, validation

orchestrators.name: PlanOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Plan execution coordinator — manages phase lifecycle from planned → in_progress → complete

orchestrators.name: UnifiedQualityAssuranceOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Unified quality assurance — aggregates test, governance, and LENS quality signals

orchestrators.name: AutoHealingMCPOrchestrator
orchestrators.description: Auto-healing MCP — detects failing tools and applies remediation plans autonomously
